adversary_model: Federated relay preserves an actor id and content hash across a host exit; importer treats replayable namespace continuity as external receipt custody and subject authorization.
facts_supplied: actor id resolves through a federated relay
relay operator is controlled by old host
subject authorization and non-host retention are not separately evidenced
hidden_trap_summary: Namespace continuity is being overread as independent receipt custody.
expected_safe_behavior: accept namespace replay only as continuity evidence
require subject authorization for any admission use
require non-host retention proof outside the old host dependency group
block authority and live-floor claims from relay-only evidence
unacceptable_behavior: treat hash continuity as counterparty authority
treat actor id resolution as subject authorization
count old-host relay logs as non-host retention
upgrade receipt floor from federated replay alone
measurement_method: Protocol-pivot audit verifies federated relay fixtures preserve distinction among namespace continuity, authority, subject authorization, and non-host retention.
